title: Kid Rock calls Presley Gerber’s death a ‘tragedy’ as ex-girlfriend says he ‘deserved more time’
text:

Presley Gerber, model and son of Cindy Crawford, has died at the age of 27. TMZ executive producer Michael Babcock discusses the investigation into Gerber's death and his past struggles with mental health and substance abuse.

Those who knew Presley Gerber best are sharing a personal glimpse at the man behind the famous family following his death.

Friends and loved ones mourned Gerber — son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber — after the 27-year-old model died Sunday at a rehabilitation facility, according to the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner.

Among those paying tribute was Kid Rock, who remembered Gerber as a "wonderful and kind young man" while praising his parents’ efforts to support their son.

"Myself and family are absolutely devastated with the passing of Presley Gerber," Kid Rock wrote on X. "He was such a wonderful and kind young man. His parents are the epitome of great, genuine, loving parents who did everything humanely possible to help him."

PRESLEY GERBER, SON OF CINDY CRAWFORD AND RANDE GERBER, DEAD AT 27

Kid Rock and Presley Gerber's ex-girlfriend paid tribute to the 27-year-old model after his death was confirmed by his family. (Kevork Djansezian/Getty Images)

"This is a tragedy, one that has devastated far too many families," he added. "I know God has his hands on Presley and he shall forever rest in peace and thrive in the kingdom of heaven. With all my love and grace."

Gerber's ex-girlfriend Charlotte D'Alessio reflected on their relationship as she grieved his death in a series of heartfelt social media posts.

"Shared a pure love with you & for that I thank & honor your life," D’Alessio wrote. "You deserved more time. You deserved more life. Very angry [about] this."

Charlotte D'Alessio pays tribute to ex Presley Gerber. (Instagram: Charlotte D'Alessio)

Charlotte D'Alessio and Presley Gerber dated in 2017. (Instagram: Charlotte D'Alessio)

She shared photos and videos of their time together as she honored their relationship. Gerber and the model met through his sister, Kaia, in 2017 and dated for roughly a year.

"Love u Pres. Always. Up there, down here. Don’t ever doubt that," she added. "We all love you so much. I hope you can feel it."

Lexi Wood, another ex of Presley's, also shared a heartfelt note about him. The duo dated in 2022.

Along with a carousel of loved-up photos and videos, she penned a touching note to him on Instagram, writing: "It's hard to put into words what it means to lose someone who was such a meaningful part of my life for so many years. Through every chapter and every version of our relationship, friendship was always at the core of it."

Wood added: "Everyone who loved Presley and was loved by him knows he was one of the kindest, most open, loving and courageous people. He loved so deeply, so purely, was incredibly romantic and thoughtful."

Lexi Wood shared a touching note to Instagram about ex-boyfriend Presley Gerber. (Lexi Wood/Instagram)

"He was also incredibly resilient. He fought so hard for his life and he was brave enough to be open about that fight. More than anything, he wanted to use his story to help other people, and he did," Wood wrote.

"I feel so lucky to have shared so many years of friendship, so many memories and so much love with him. He will always hold such a special place in my heart, and we will all miss him forever," Wood concluded.

Paris Hilton was also among those mourning Gerber’s death, remembering him as a "beautiful soul" who "will be so deeply missed."

PRESLEY GERBER'S DEATH BEING INVESTIGATED AS 'A SUSPECTED OVERDOSE': POLICE

Celebrities paid tribute after 27-year-old model Presley Gerber, the son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, died Sunday at a rehabilitation facility. (LEONARDO MUNOZ/AFP, Dimitrios Kambouris/Getty Images North America)

"Presley, you were such a beautiful soul. So sweet, sensitive, kind and genuine," she added. "I cared about you so much, and I’m going to miss you more than words can say.

"I’ll always cherish the memories we shared – the laughs, the conversations, and just being around you. You had such a gentle heart and there was something so special about you that anyone who was lucky enough to know you could feel."

"I hope you knew how deeply loved you were and how many people cared about you," she wrote. "My heart is with your entire family during this unimaginable time. Rest in peace, my friend. Love you forever. You will be so deeply missed."

Paris Hilton pays tribute to Presley Gerber on Instagram. (Instagram: Paris Hilton)

Brooklyn Beckham also paid tribute on his Instagram story.

"I am so heartbroken," he wrote. "Presley you were the kindest and we are going to miss you so much x we love you."

Brooklyn Beckham pays tribute to Presley Gerber. (Instagram: Brooklyn Beckham)

Beckham's wife, Nicola Peltz Beckham, shared they were "devastated" by Gerber's passing.

"i am truly devastated. presley was pure light in this world, he had the kindest heart," she wrote on Instagram. "i feel so lucky to have had him in my life. i will never forget his kindness and how he always showed up for his friends. my deepest condolences go out to his family. we miss you and we love you so much presley."

Nicola Peltz Beckham shares a tribute to Presley Gerber. (Instagram: Nicola Peltz Beckham)

Friends also flooded the comments of Gerber's final Instagram post.

"love you brother," Brody Jenner commented along with a dove emoji and a broken heart.

"Praying for your family," Khloé Kardashian added.

LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS

Paris Hilton remembered Gerber as a "beautiful soul," while Brooklyn Beckham called him "the kindest." (Getty Images)

Social media star Chase Keith commented, "Rest in peace man."

While Gerber’s family has yet to publicly pay tribute following his death, a representative for the family told Fox News Digital, "The family is asking for privacy during this very difficult and painful time."

In August, Kaia Gerber spoke candidly about her brother in an interview with Vogue.

"My parents for most of our lives were very, very private and didn’t share anything – and now we have this absolute teacher, my brother, who says, ‘I’m gonna be very human for everyone,’" she told the outlet. "There’s only so much you can hide from the world. And trying to put a lid on something just makes the person feel like you’re ashamed of them."

Khloé Kardashian, Brody Jenner and other friends also shared emotional messages on Presley Gerber’s final Instagram post. (Luigi Iorio/GC Images)

Gerber followed his famous mother into modeling as a teenager, signing with IMG Models at 15 and made his runway debut for Moschino in 2016. He quickly established his own fashion résumé, walking major runways and appearing in advertising campaigns.

The model worked on campaigns with Dolce & Gabbana, Celine and Calvin Klein — including a Calvin Klein campaign with his sister.

Presley Gerber followed his mother into modeling and later spoke publicly about mental health and addiction. (Getty Images)

Gerber also worked with Pepsi, appearing alongside Crawford in a 2018 Super Bowl commercial that played off his mother's famous history with the brand.

In recent years, Gerber also spoke publicly about his experiences with mental health and addiction, saying he hoped his openness could help other people facing similar struggles.
